decisions.decision: Shell out to `claude -p` CLI subprocesses; do NOT embed the Claude Agent SDK.
decisions.rationale: Anthropic compliance docs forbid using Free/Pro/Max OAuth tokens with the Agent SDK (requires a metered Console API key). `claude -p` CLI on Max is explicitly sanctioned. June 15 2026 moves programmatic `claude -p` to a dedicated monthly credit pool — quota economics, not a build gate.

decisions.decision: Use Playwright MCP for autonomous QA agents. Keep Claude-in-Chrome for interactive (human/Code-driven) QA per existing website CLAUDE.md convention.
decisions.rationale: No open-source project drives the Claude-in-Chrome extension from a headless orchestrator. Playwright MCP is the de-facto agent-QA browser layer (Microsoft, Apache-2.0, mature, headless). Slight reinterpretation of goal 4's 'or similar' wording.

decisions.decision: Stay co-located in the liquid-democracy repo through WA1/WA2. Split into a dedicated repo before the live daemon (WA4).
decisions.rationale: Lowest-friction validation; reuses repo context. WA4 onward the orchestrator is a separate project that may orchestrate beyond Liquid Democracy. IPC files still land in this repo where Code works.
